description: Scope: what the workflows pin. npm packages, the Dockerfile base images and the compose service images arrive with upstream merges, so Renovate leaves them alone. The Bun version is set in package.json, four Dockerfiles, ci.yml and docs/development.md: raise all seven by hand in one change.

packageRules.description: Workflow actions: one PR, each pinned to a commit with its tag in a comment
publish-chart.yml is written for Helm 4. Read the Helm 5 breaking changes before raising this limit.
Runner images: the manifest job names ubuntu-24.04, and the build matrix names ubuntu-24.04 and ubuntu-24.04-arm where Renovate cannot see them. Move all three by hand after a trial run.
